newsitem.title: USA: Maxam Gold sets warrant distribution.
newsitem.headline: Maxam Gold sets warrant distribution.

text.p: Maxam Gold Corp said Friday it will issue warrants to its shareholders of record as of March 13.
One warrant will be issued for each five shares held. Each warrant will entitle the holder the right to buy one share of Maxam common at $1 within a period of two years from March 14.
The company will file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission registering the warrants and underlying shares.
The company intends to use proceeds from the exercise of these warrants to develop Peoria South Mine, a gold mine near Phoeniz, Ariz., which is targeted for production in mid-1998.
